objects.name: principledVolume
objects.description: participating-medium volume with scattering, absorption, emission and blackbody terms

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: spatial field holding the density values

parameters.name: valueRange
parameters.description: sampled values of the field are clamped to this range

parameters.name: unitDistance
parameters.description: makes the volume uniformly thinner or thicker

parameters.name: scatterColor
parameters.description: scattering color; falls back to 'color' when unset

parameters.name: densityThreshold
parameters.description: densities below this threshold are treated as empty

parameters.name: scatteringAlbedo
parameters.description: single-scattering albedo; derived from 'absorptionColor' when unset

parameters.name: blackbodyIntensity
parameters.description: intensity of blackbody emission driven by 'temperature'

parameters.name: blackbodyTint
parameters.description: tint applied to the blackbody emission
